title: Calculating coefficients of variation for data independent acquisition-based proteomics
projectDescription: Reanalysis of the Kawashima et al dataset with DIA-NN and Spectronaut. By using different settings this shows how the CVs can be altered by the software parameters.
sampleProcessingProtocol: No specific labwork was done for this dataset. The specific processing details can be found at https://pubs.acs.org/doi/full/10.1021/acs.jproteome.2c00023 and ProteomeXchange Consortium identifier PXD029853 and PXD032698..
dataProcessingProtocol: Data were analysed with DIA-NN version 1.8 and with Spectronaut version 17. Spectronaut searches were performed with the default parameters, and an alternate search without Top 3 and without normalisation. The DIA-NN searches focussed on 'high precision' and 'high accuracy' quantification strategies.
